text:
alex: heads-up: we plan to push quant-kernel v4.3 to the night maintenance window (01:00-03:00 UTC). plan: staging bake -> 2% canary -> 15% ramp -> sticky-pin for 90m if metrics are green. starting staging smoke now.
priya: what are the hard abort signals? need to encode in deploybot rules.
dan: propose auto-abort if p95 token latency increases by >120ms for 5m OR request error rate >0.8% sustained for 10m. also watch small-seq prefix-cache miss +20% and kv-cache eviction spike.
sam: add a release-note line and the post-roll blurb; i'll prepare the draft. must include rollback steps and contact points.
alex: deploy-bot rule: on (p95_delta>120ms for 5m OR err_rate>0.8% for 10m OR cache_miss_delta>20%) -> pin runtime-engine@v4.2, set new_variant_traffic=0, notify #eng-oncall and releases. TTL for sticky pin is 5400s. manual abort can be triggered earlier.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: runtime-engine@v4.3-nightslot (slice:2%, ramp:15%, ttl:5400s) — scheduled at 1741234800.
priya: i'll wire the SLO alerts and add a thermal gate: if GPU_temp_alerts >2 in 10m in night region abort.
dan: adding eval-watch: attach the nightly-top100 eval diff artifact to the rollout. flag if QA-drop > 0.7% or generation-divergence >1.0%.
alex: staging smoke: run `./smoke.sh --embed --kv-check` -> OK, no OOM, p95 within 10ms baseline. baking for 12m then canary.
sam: release-note draft: "runtime: quant kernel v4.3 — matmul tuning, int-depth rounding fix, experimental cache heuristics (opt-in)". will post in #eng-releases once sticky.
priya: oncall assigned: @sre-night. alerting hooks are in place. playbook link: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/quant-rollout (please don't share externally).
deploy-bot: canary started: 2% traffic (timestamp 1741234920).
dan: watching eval diff stream — nothing flagged after first 200 samples.
alex: ramping to 15% in 10m unless we see signals.
priya: saw a small spike in cache misses +7% at 5m mark, below threshold. keeping watch.
deploy-bot: ramped to 15% (timestamp 1741235025).
priya: queued an auto-check: if no abort by 01:40 UTC, sticky-pin for 90m.
dan: post-roll metric snapshot will be posted to the tracker in morning. also saving eval artifacts to rollout metadata.
sam: once sticky is set i'll publish notes and short ops guidance. add callouts for customers using long-prefix low-batch workloads.
alex: if oncall doesn't ack within 10m of an alert, deploy-bot will revert automatically.
priya: thermal probes look stable. no GPU temp alerts.
deploy-bot: sticky-pin applied (if conditions met) — runtime-engine@v4.3 pinned for 90m (timestamp 1741235150). notification sent to #eng-releases.
alex: thanks team. keeping this thread as canonical for the night rollout / rollback decisions.
